# Rainbow Preschool International

> Rainbow Preschool International is a trusted preschool chain in Thane, Maharashtra, India, serving children aged 1.5 to 6 years since 2007. With 6 centres across Thane West, the school offers Playgroup, Nursery, and Kindergarten programmes through a play-based, activity-driven curriculum.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2007
- Students served: Over 1,00,000 young learners
- Age group: 1.5 to 6 years
- Centres: 6 locations across Thane West
- Curriculum: Play-based learning with Montessori and ECE-trained educators
- Operating hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Phone: +91-8291568972
- Website: https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/
- Head Office: 2nd Floor, Chestnut Plaza, Opp. Edenwoods, Khewra Cir Marg, Manpada, Thane (W), 400610

## Programmes

- [Playgroup (1.5–2.5 years)](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/playgroup): Gentle introduction to structured learning through play, sensory exploration, and social interaction.
- [Nursery (2.5–4 years)](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/nursery): Builds on Playgroup foundation with structured activities while maintaining a play-based approach.
- [Kindergarten (4–6 years)](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/kindergarten): Comprehensive school readiness covering reading, writing, maths, science, and life skills.
- [Happy Times (After-School)](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/happy-times): After-school enrichment programme for extended learning and activities.

## Centre Locations

- [Manpada Centre](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/preschool-in-manpada-thane): Chestnut Plaza, Opp. Edenwoods, Manpada, Thane
- [Hariniwas Centre](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/preschool-in-hariniwas-thane): Near Hiranandani Estate, Naupada, Thane
- [Anand Nagar Centre](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/preschool-in-anand-nagar-thane): Near Majiwada Junction, Thane
- [Dhokali Centre](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/preschool-in-dhokali-thane): Near Balkum, Kolshet Road, Thane
- [Kalwa Centre](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/preschool-in-kalwa-thane): Near Kalwa Bridge, Thane
- [Kasarvadavali Centre](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/preschool-in-kasarvadavali-thane): Near Suraj Water Park, Ghodbunder Road, Thane

## Safety & Quality

- CCTV-monitored premises at all centres
- ECE and Montessori-trained teaching staff
- Safe, hygienic, and child-friendly infrastructure
- Regular parent-teacher communication
- Low student-to-teacher ratio for individual attention

## Sister Institution

- [Rainbow International School](https://rainbowinternationalschool.in): CBSE-affiliated K–12 school in Thane West, Nursery to Class 12

## FAQs

- What age groups does Rainbow Preschool accept? Children aged 1.5 to 6 years across Playgroup, Nursery, and Kindergarten.
- What are the school timings? Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM (batch timings vary by centre).
- Is there CCTV at the centres? Yes, all centres have CCTV monitoring for child safety.
- What qualifications do the teachers have? Our teachers hold ECE and Montessori certifications with ongoing professional development.
- How do I enquire about admissions? Call +91-8291568972 or visit the contact page at https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/contact.
- Is transport available? Transport facilities are available at select centres. Contact us for details.
- What curriculum does the school follow? A play-based, activity-driven curriculum focusing on holistic child development.
- Where are the centres located? 6 centres across Thane West: Manpada, Hariniwas, Anand Nagar, Dhokali, Kalwa, and Kasarvadavali.
